mistake_reason: At step 8, FileSurfer reported only three matching slides (3, 4, 8) despite having extracted full slide text that included an additional crustacean mention on slide 10 (the term 'krill'). WebSurfer explicitly listed 'krill' as a crustacean keyword, and the orchestrator requested a comprehensive keyword search across slides and notes. FileSurfer withheld the 'krill' hit from its summary and subsequent rechecks, filtering out a critical data point. This withholding (FM-2.4 Information Withholding) led the team to undercount and deliver the wrong final answer.
